one_line: A Hellenistic-descended merchant operating along Indo-Greek trade routes between the Indus, Barygaza, and the Indian Ocean in the 1st century CE.

appearance.age_look: late 20s, lean but sturdy build, slightly travel-worn
appearance.face: oval face with a straight nose and high cheekbones, light olive complexion tanned by coastal sun, short trimmed beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with a calm, calculating gaze, default expression a composed half-smile suggesting quiet confidence in negotiations
appearance.hair: wavy dark-brown hair cut to the nape of the neck, combed back from the forehead with a slight tousle at the crown, held by a narrow brown leather headband; no helmet, just the simple band as a practical traveler’s accessory
appearance.costume: knee-length Hellenistic-style chiton in undyed off-white linen with a narrow sky-blue border along the neckline and hem, belted at the waist with a medium-brown leather belt; above it, a light woollen himation-style mantle in muted teal draped over the left shoulder and wrapped around the torso, pinned at the right shoulder with a small bronze fibula; fitted, ankle-length loose trousers in pale beige cotton or fine wool (reflecting Indo-Iranian influence), tucked into simple brown leather boots with laces; minimal jewellery: a single thin bronze bangle on the right wrist and a small bronze ring on the left hand; across his body runs a sturdy, medium-brown leather strap from which hangs a practical, rectangular, dark-brown leather satchel resting at his right hip.
appearance.signature: a worn wooden counting board with shallow carved grooves, held in one hand alongside a small drawstring pouch of Indo-Greek silver drachmas and local copper coins, occasionally shown with one Menander-style coin visible between his fingers

ref_desc: A late-20s Indo-Greek merchant with tanned olive skin, short wavy dark-brown hair held by a brown leather headband, off-white chiton, teal himation, beige trousers, brown boots and belt, carrying a dark-brown satchel and a wooden counting board with coin pouch, in a sky-blue and muted-teal palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-20s Indo-Greek merchant: oval face, light olive skin tanned by travel, straight nose, short trimmed beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes and a calm, confident half-smile; short wavy dark-brown hair cut to the nape, combed back with a narrow brown leather headband. He wears a knee-length off-white linen chiton with a narrow sky-blue border at neckline and hem, belted at the waist with a medium-brown leather belt, over ankle-length loose pale-beige trousers tucked into simple brown leather lace-up boots. Over his left shoulder is a muted-teal woollen himation-style mantle wrapped around the torso and pinned at the right shoulder with a small bronze fibula, the drapery clearly shown from multiple angles. Add a thin bronze bangle on his right wrist and a small bronze ring on his left hand. A sturdy medium-brown leather strap crosses his chest, supporting a rectangular dark-brown leather satchel at his right hip. His signature prop is a worn wooden counting board with carved grooves in one hand and a small drawstring pouch of mixed Indo-Greek silver drachmas and local copper coins in the other, one coin visible between his fingers. Use a restrained palette of off-white, sky blue, muted teal, beige, and medium brown, and present him in neutral, front, side, and three-quarter poses to clearly show face, hair, clothing layers, and the counting board with coin pouch.
